newsitem.title: HONDURAS: Central American bank places $250 million bond.
newsitem.headline: Central American bank places $250 million bond.

text.p: The Central American Bank for Economic Integration has placed a five-year bond worth $250 million with investors in Taiwan, an official said on Monday.

"The reason for my trip to the Republic of Taiwan was to meet with a group of investors interested in supporting the (bank) and in collaboration with the Chinese we placed a bond issue for the order of $250 million," said the president of the regional bank, Jose Pacas Castro.
The funds will be used for the bank's development projects, he said.
The bonds were denominated in New Taiwan dollars.
The regional development bank has its headquarters in Tegucigalpa, capital of Honduras.
